description: The source names this dataset for a study of PCN-222 thin films on ceramic foam used to remove disinfection byproducts through sorption and visible-light photocatalysis. It also identifies a related poster on metal-organic frameworks for DBP removal. These are experiments on a physical water-treatment material; the metadata do not establish that every referenced publication uses identical observations. The source authors provide these water-quality study data; geographic coverage is not stated. The source marks the data restricted while publishing CC BY 4.0 metadata. No access procedure, fee, availability date or permission to obtain the underlying files is established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Data values, archives, images and linked article or poster bodies remain unread. The reported treatment subject establishes the resource role, while measurement quality, independent sample counts and overlap with related experiments remain unverified.
